averaging_transfer_obstruction.claim: A common spatial or irrational-rotation average does not by itself imply phase constancy of a finite rational-rotation trace.
averaging_transfer_obstruction.deduction: For any positive integer N and integer coprime turn tau, g(x)=cos(2*pi*N*x) has uniform integral0. Each g(x+j*tau/N)=cos(2*pi*N*x), so its N-term trace is N*cos(2*pi*N*x), attaining N and -N at phases0 and1/(2N). For irrational rotation alpha, the normalized exponential sum is bounded by2/(M*abs(1-exp(2*pi*i*N*alpha))) and tends to0. Thus agreement with an aperiodic spatial average cannot supply the target-specific cancellation premise.
